page.layout: One printed page, cut off at the right. Page number at top left. Two small woodcut figures stand above and beside the text block on the left. Faded show-through text lies in the centre and right, not printed on this page. One block of running text below the figures, its right side cut off.; One page of text, cut at the left side, with woodcut figures A, B, C, D above; running head at top; main text in full lines below the figures, no marginal notes visible.

main_text.p: Porro est lapidis nerus) qu manicè E vel D. H nora vel mina con tes Plini Ragenste arenario me misit pres-Ben ex tribus figuris hic expressis, prima seu B ex multis veluti pisis concreti) inquit Ges- nerus Pifolithon vel Orobiam dixerim (Ger- manice Erbstein) vel Hammitè maiorem. Secunda Hammitem minorem; qui ova piscium mi- aranearam refert, ut papaveris miliive se- globata (unde & Meconites, & Cenchri- tes vocari possit.) Agricola Rogenstein vel Rogenstein interpretatur, quod tamen nomen Saxo quoque tribuit. Hunc lapidem Berna ad Virum Doctissimum Sacrarum literarum inter- pretem Aretius, duplicem: album è Iura monte:

page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off, so many lines end in fragments and are given as far as they show. Two woodcut figures (a round, netted object at top and a granular, knobbed object in the middle) are illustrations and not transcribed. The faint text at the centre and right is show-through from the other side of the leaf and is left out. "pres-Ben" ends with a printed hyphen, which I have kept. Left edge of the printed text is cut off; words are cut at the left, so some partial words are reconstructed from their visible endings and are uncertain. The figures are woodcuts and are not transcribed.
